stratagems.name: Warp Surge
stratagems.target: One CHAOS DAEMONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Daemonic Ritual
stratagems.target: One CHAOS DAEMONS PSYKER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Roll 3D6. For each result of 4+, place one Warp Token. At the end of the phase, you can spend any number of Warp Tokens: for each Token spent, one friendly CHAOS DAEMONS unit within 12" of your PSYKER regains 1 lost wound.

stratagems.name: Blood for the Blood God
stratagems.target: One KHORNE DAEMONS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in your unit. In addition, each time a model in your unit destroys an enemy model, that model can immediately make one additional attack with one of its melee weapons.

stratagems.name: Plaguebearer's Resilience
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One CHAOS DAEMONS unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit would lose a wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, that wound is not lost.
